title: gentianella setipes
intro: Gentianella setipes, commonly known as the Alpine Gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family, characterized by its small, delicate flowers and slender stems. The health benefits of Gentianella setipes include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Gentianella setipes include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
